items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 June 2026 4:31pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 12 June 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure north of Scotland, high pressure near Biscay gradually transferring northwards.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 this evening, occasionally 7 in places overnight, then decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in places, veering northwest tomorrow evening, becoming variable 3 or less later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers at first.
